fullContent:
Mahasneham Ghrita – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Ashtanga Hridayam 
 Introduction 
 Mahasneham Ghrita is a classical Ayurvedic Formulation useful in all Vata disorders. It is useful both internally and externally. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Jeevaka 
 Madhuka 
 Rushabhaka 
 Mahamedha 
 Medha 
 Mashaparni 
 Mudgaparni 
 Ksheera Kakoli 
 Kakoli, Pundara 
 Thuka 
 Vruddhi 
 Padmaka 
 Taila 
 Majja 
 Vasa 
 Grita 
 Jeevanti 
 Amruta 
 Shringi 
 Rudhi 
 Amla Dadhi 
 Anoopamamsa 
 Baladwaya 
 Kushta 
 Nata 
 Bhadradaru 
 Kola 
 Yava 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All ingredients are added and cooked as ghrit paak method. 
 Dose 
 Use 10-20gm, 1-2 times a day. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 This Ayurvedic medicine is useful in every type of rheumatic diseases. 
 It is also good to promote body strength. 
 It can even increase the quantity and quality of semen. 
 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 Use it under medical directions. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
